subject: Samir Khatri — final call: competing offer & sign-by window
messages:
From: recruiter@upward.io
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Candidate update — Samir Khatri has a competing offer (72h window)

Hi Ben / Monica —

Quick update from Samir's call this morning. He received a competing written offer from a stealth infra startup. They have the candidate excited and have given him a 72‑hour window to respond.

Candidate highlights:
- Samir Khatri (ex‑Databricks senior infra engineer)
- Base on current Redwood offer: $210,000 + 18% RSU refresh over 4y + $12k signing bonus (draft attached)
- Competing offer is higher base ($235k) but slightly lower equity; includes $15k signing

Samir is seeking either a base adjustment or a guaranteed near‑term refresh to close. He prefers Redwood but timing is the driver.

What he needs from Redwood: a firm counter (base or signing + equity clarity) and a firm sign‑by date within 72h.

Can you confirm runway (band flexibility, signing bonus headroom) and whether we can issue an updated offer by EOD tomorrow? I attached Samir's short resume and his note.

Attachments: Samir_Profile.pdf, Candidate_Note.txt

Thanks,
- Priya on behalf of Upward Recruiting
(recruiter@upward.io)
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: recruiter@upward.io, samir.k@talentmail.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-08T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate update — Samir Khatri has a competing offer (72h window)

Thanks Priya — and thanks Samir for flagging this quickly. We want to move fast. Internal notes below and a couple of asks so we respond with a firm, signable offer.

Immediate asks (to Upward / Samir):
1) Can you confirm the competing offer total cash, target OTE, and exact acceptance deadline (include timezone)?
2) Any non‑compete or relocation clauses in their offer?

Internal: Monica / Laura — quick ask: is there flexibility to either (A) raise base to $225k (band lift) or (B) keep base at $210k + increase signing bonus to $30k + guaranteed 2027 refresh equal to 0.5% additional RSUs (one‑time)? I prefer option B if equity approval takes longer.

If you can greenlight either path, I will issue an updated offer with a hard sign‑by window (example: 2026‑12‑13 23:59 PST). I attached the current draft offer for reference (Offer_Redwood_SE_IC.pdf) and a short candidate counter draft (Samir_Counter_Request.pdf) that he sent this morning.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Talent Partnerships (acting hiring lead)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Offer_Redwood_SE_IC.pdf, Samir_Counter_Request.pdf
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-08T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate update — Samir Khatri has a competing offer (72h window)

Ben / Monica —

I've reviewed the profile and the prelim numbers. Authorize the following one‑time exceptions to close high‑impact infra hires this quarter:

- Signing bonus: up to $25,000 (one‑time) — APPROVED
- Equity: we can guarantee a one‑time 0.35% RSU grant as a refresh target for 2027 (requires People Ops confirmation for grant cadence) — PROVISIONAL
- Base band uplift to $220,000 requires a comp‑band exception and approval from People Ops; not recommended as fastest path

So please proceed with option B (maintain base at $210k, $25k signing, 0.35% guaranteed refresh) and make the sign‑by window explicit. Include the HR onboarding contact and typical start date range (we can be flexible +/- 2 weeks).

Open actions for Ben: open HIRE ticket and include candidate acceptance deadline; CC People Ops to finalize equity cadence.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: samir.k@talentmail.com, recruiter@upward.io
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-09T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Updated Redwood offer & sign‑by window (Samir Khatri)

Samir / Priya —

Thanks for holding the line. We want Redwood to be the right long‑term home and have approved a revised offer to keep you whole on timing. Summary of updated offer (see attached PDF and DocuSign):

- Base salary: $210,000 (unchanged)
- Signing bonus: $25,000 (one‑time, paid first payroll)
- Guaranteed refresh: 0.35% RSUs target (to be granted in 2027; People Ops finalizes cadence)
- Standard benefits, relocation/remote terms unchanged

Please review the attached updated offer: Offer_Redwood_SE_IC.pdf. We've also prepared a DocuSign envelope to streamline signature: https://docusign.com/Redwood/Envelope/ABC123456789

We need a signed acceptance by: 2026‑12‑13T23:59:00-08:00 (PST). If we do not receive acceptance by that window, we will assume the candidate is pursuing the competing offer and the revised terms may be retracted.

If you accept, reply to this thread and sign the DocuSign. Once signed, recruiting will loop in onboarding and People Ops to lock the refresh cadence.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Talent Partnerships (acting hiring lead)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Offer_Redwood_SE_IC.pdf
From: Samir Khatri <samir.k@talentmail.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: recruiter@upward.io
Date: 2026-12-10T11:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated Redwood offer & sign‑by window (Samir Khatri)

Ben / Priya —

Thank you — I appreciate the quick turnaround and the revised terms. I am inclined to accept. Two quick clarifying questions before I sign:
1) Can we move the proposed start date earlier by one week (from Jan 19 to Jan 12)? I have a flexible end date with my current employer and could start sooner.
2) For the 0.35% refresh grant: will the grant documentation include a vesting schedule (standard 4y) and a cliff? I just want that on record before I sign.

If both are OK, I will sign the DocuSign tonight and confirm. Please let me know the start‑date flexibility and whether People Ops will confirm the grant cadence prior to DocuSign or as a post‑signing onboarding step.

Appreciate the help — Samir
